title: perf(canary): automated regression detector and rollout guard hysteresis
author: Ava Martinez
description: Introduce an automated performance-regression detector for the perf-canary pipeline and add hysteresis-based rollout guards to prevent noisy flips during borderline regressions. Motivation: we have seen several incidents where brief latency spikes during rollout caused immediate rollbacks or unsafe roll-forwards, creating churn and reduced confidence in canary automation. This PR adds a statistical detector that compares current canary latency/throughput distributions to baseline with configurable sensitivity, and a hysteresis policy that requires sustained violations before taking automated rollback actions. Key changes: 1) detector service in perf-canary that computes sliding-window KS/t-test + MMD fallback for heavy-tailed metrics; 2) rollout guard state machine with probe, warn, pause, rollback transitions and configurable durations; 3) metrics and tracing for detector decisions and guard state transitions; 4) integration with routing layer to mark routes as paused and automatic safe-fallback to previous model variant; 5) canary UI: new section showing recent detector alerts and state history. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for detector thresholds and state transitions - [x] end-to-end perf tests against synthetic load profiles - [x] canary UI wiring and RBAC checks - [x] manual QA on staging with traffic replay - [x] added Linear tasks and documentation. Related: ENG-1823, ENG-1901. Note: this PR touches both control-plane canary orchestration and runtime routing guards; changes are designed to be opt-in via canary config flags. Merge strategy: squash.
commits: feat(canary): add perf regression detector microservice and API
feat(guards): implement hysteresis-based rollout guard state machine
perf(test): synthetic workload harness and e2e canary scenario
docs(canary): add detector/guard docs and config examples
chore(ci): add perf integration job and flakiness thresholds
review_comments: Liam Chen: Nice overall design. Two asks: (1) make the detector thresholds configurable per-team and document SLO guidance; (2) please add a safety timeout for paused routes so they don't remain indefinitely. -- addressed in state_machine.go and config example.

Priya Kapoor: Can you add a regression test that simulates a brief spike vs sustained degradation? We should assert that hysteresis lets short spikes pass but flags sustained issues. -- added synthetic workload harness with 60s vs 10m profiles.

Noah Patel: Runtime change looks safe, but ensure fallback handler preserves KV cache compatibility. Suggest adding cache warmup signal when we switch variants. -- added warmup signal and documented behavior.
Elena Ruiz: UI copy nits and RBAC scoping were requested. Updated CanaryGuardPanel to hide control buttons for non-admins and added tooltip explanations.
discussion_summary: Reviewers requested team-specific threshold config, a pause timeout, and cache warmup on fallback. All items addressed; tests added for brief vs sustained regressions. UI and RBAC tweaks applied. Consensus to opt-in the new detector via canary config defaulting to off in main until gradual rollout.
testing_summary: Local unit tests: 100% pass. Staging synthetic runs: 10 canary scenarios across 3 regions with traffic replay; detector fired 2 sustained regressions and correctly paused rollouts for 15m; short spikes (30s bursts) were ignored per hysteresis. Perf integration job added to CI to run weekly. Observability: new metrics perf_canary.detector.{alerts,score}, perf_canary.guard.state emitted and wired to dashboards in grafana staging.
release_notes: Add automated perf canary regression detector and hysteresis-based rollout guards; opt-in via canary config; exposes new metrics perf_canary.detector.alerts and perf_canary.guard.state; adds UI panel for guard history.
motivation: Reduce noisy canary churn and avoid automated rollbacks from transient latency spikes by adding statistical detection and hysteresis guards.
security_implications: Minimal. Accessible only to canary controllers with existing RBAC. No secrets added. Audit logs emitted for guard transitions.
deploy_notes: Enable detector via canary_config.detector.enabled=false->true as a staged rollout. Recommended rollout: enable in staging, then 10% of traffic in dedicated canaries for 48h before wider rollout. CI will run perf-integration weekly to catch regressions.
